q3_lower_bounds.canonical_source: Read from results/E8_second_backbone/E8_cells_intphys2.json, not from the task sheet. Across E8's six models: **trained beats raw_pixel 6/6 and beats vae_latent 6/6**, while the vae-vs-random order flips by model (cogvideox2b/5b and wan21_14b/1b3 put vae above random, ltx and mochi put random above vae). So the load-bearing claim is 'trained beats both non-DiT arms 6/6'; the three-way order the task sheet sketched ('trained > random > pixel') is NOT what E8 measured -- random_dit never clears raw_pixel in any of the six. E19 is judged on the two claims E8 actually established.
q3_lower_bounds.note: PREREG-equivalent judgement is the ORDER, not the values: each backbone is measured on its own features and absolute AUC is not comparable across models (E8 §14). A break in the order is a finding, not noise.
